A '''hypodermic injector''', '''hypoinjector''' or '''medjector'''<ref name="ODSTM">{{JournalCite|10|Only Droids Serve the Maker}}</ref> was a tool employed by [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] and [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droids]], typically installed on [[injection arm]]s. Additionally, the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] could have its hands removed and replaced with hypodermic injectors for use in operating rooms.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
